rationale: X's top-billed finding (integer version= silently no-ops) is directly contradicted by the author's own follow-up comment explaining version=1/2 are valid git-branch refs, hurting its precision, but X's #3 (varlen_func called unconditionally when only flash_attn_func is guaranteed) is a real, ungrounded-fixed bug in the same family as RuixiangMa's GT4 finding, giving it the only meaningful recall hit either candidate scores. Y's four findings (broaden except clause, wrap default get_kernel call, class duplication) are all technically accurate and well-anchored, giving it higher precision, but none overlap with the nine actual reviewer concerns (version docs, skipif markers, SM90 gating, strict-vs-try/except test validation) and two of them (wanting more exception wrapping) actually cut against what real reviewers wanted (less silent swallowing). Both are concrete and file/line-anchored with similar actionability; X edges out on being more useful/grounded overall despite the flawed headline claim.
